results.title: Isoform-specific single-cell perturb-seq reveals distinct functions of alternative promoters in drug response
results.content: To implement our Isoform-Specific Perturb-Seq approach, we generated MCF-7 breast cancer cells stably expressing dCas9-CRISPRi. We selected MCF-7 cells due to their well-characterized alternative promoter usage and clinical relevance in breast cancer studies. To ensure robust knockdown, we employed a dual guide RNA strategy, targeting each promoter with two sgRNAs (Fig.2A andB,Supplementary Fig. S2, and Supplementary Tables S1 and S2, see the ‘Materials and methods’ section). Initial validation
